data.title: 双叶理央 · 海滨观测站的防水实验
data.description: 【海滨科学观测站·正午】理央穿着深蓝运动泳装与白色防晒外套，蹲在潮池旁记录水温；她把防水平板举向镜头展示一只小螃蟹从石缝探出，眼神在海风里显得比平时活泼。
data.action: 潮池旁记录水温，发现小螃蟹后把防水平板举给镜头看
data.lighting: clear noon light with glassy tide-pool reflections
data.mood: 把研究对象变成假日惊喜
data.promptProse: Crouching at the tide-pool observation station, Rio Futaba records the water temperature on a tablet enclosed in a transparent waterproof pouch, then angles it toward the viewer as a tiny crab emerges between rocks. Her navy athletic swimsuit, white sun jacket and clear safety glasses retain the field outfit. The horizontal medium view follows the rock basin behind her. Noon sun brightens the tablet's cover and wet stone, while pool reflections flicker on her sleeves.
